plan: Given my value of $33, I should bid slightly below this value to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. Rational bidders will bid slightly below their value, knowing others do the same. A bid of $32.9 could be optimal, as it allows for a small profit if I win, assuming other bidders value the prize close to or below $32.9. This bid balances the risk of losing with the potential profit.

Given my value is $34, which is above the maximum possible value of $20, I have an advantage. Rational bidders will not bid above their value. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly above $20 to ensure winning while minimizing cost. A bid of $20.1 should suffice, as it exceeds the maximum possible value for others. This strategy ensures I win and pay the second-highest bid, which will be their maximum value of $20 or less.

Given my value of $25, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive expected profit. Bidding exactly $25 risks zero profit if I win, and bidding above $25 guarantees a loss. Rational bidders will bid slightly below their values, so I should aim to bid around $24 to maximize my chance of winning while ensuring profit.
